task.description: Implement DDL-02, ORD-01, ORD-02, ORD-04 per the validated (PASS, one resolved rework cycle) design artefacts. DDL-02: extend src/platform/ddl_validate.zig's existing ValidatePlatformDDL with the new checkConstrainBeforeExpand check (per-column state machine UNSEEN/EXPANDED/BACKFILLED across statements in file order), add file/byte_offset fields to StatementDescriptor (purely additive, confirmed safe for DDL-05's ddl_namespace.zig by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR -- update DDL-01's existing unit test call sites that construct StatementDescriptor literals to supply these two new fields). ORD-01/02/04: run tools/codegen_migration.py on both Type C YAMLs (plat_effect_completion, plat_correlation_cursor tables), then write the consumer claim (SELECT...FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)/execute-guard (pg_try_advisory_xact_lock per correlation)/observability (lag, oldest-pending-age, guard-false-rate) logic in new src/ordering/ modules, following the src/effects/worker.zig connection-acquisition discipline (GH-654/ISS-0649 -- never hold a connection across a poll sleep). Read both design docs in full before writing any code.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in DDL-02, ORD-01, ORD-02, ORD-04 is implemented
No mocks/stubs/fakes; all DB access via real PostgreSQL through the Pool
Real unit + integration tests written and passing, with own addTest/build.zig wiring (verified real by deliberate-break test)

result.summary: Implemented DDL-02 (checkConstrainBeforeExpand extension to ValidatePlatformDDL, per-column UNSEEN/EXPANDED/BACKFILLED state machine, new file/byte_offset StatementDescriptor fields, all existing DDL-01 test call sites updated) and ORD-01/02/04 (codegen'd plat_effect_completion + plat_correlation_cursor Type C migrations, new src/ordering/{mod,cursor,consumer,observability}.zig implementing the claim guard / execute guard / parallelism-lag observability, following effects/worker.zig's connection-acquisition discipline with an explicit ORD-03 stub extension point). All acceptance criteria for DDL-02, ORD-01, ORD-02, ORD-04 implemented and covered by real tests against PostgreSQL (no mocks). All gates PASS: zig build, zig build migrate, zig build check (scoped fmt), lint_sql_param_types.py (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR), zig build test (95/95 steps, 1053/1117 tests, 64 pre-existing skips, 0 failures), and the new targeted steps test-ddl-validate (28/28), test-ordering (4/4), test-integration-ord01 (3/3), test-integration-ord04 (4/4), test-integration-ordering (8/8). Build-wiring verified real via deliberate-break-then-revert on both a pure unit test (observability.zig) and a DB integration test (ordering_consumer_test.zig).
